newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Vulnerable cocoa could grapple with support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Vulnerable cocoa could grapple with support.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
London's benchmark July cocoa contract will have to hold above the 980 stg recent reaction low to avoid sliding further to psychological support at 900 stg, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
Last week July finally slipped through 1,000 stg and the close on Friday -- London's last trading session -- was technically weak at 995 stg despite an intraday high of 1,000 stg.

"I think the market is vulnerable rather than in a downtrend," said Adrian Haylor, a technical analyst at Sucden. "But if it breaks through 980 and 975, then you will probably see a push lower to 900."
July should also derive support from a 50-percent Fibonacci retracement point based on the upmove from a 885 stg February low to April's 1,065 stg peak, he said.
"There is support in the area and while there's support, there's still hope for the market."
Since its breakaway gap from 982 to 1,002 stg in early March, July's volatile trading pattern has created a double top formation on the charts and also produced reaction lows around 980 stg.
Traders called the London market to open unchanged from Friday's close.

New York cocoa futures ended modestly higher on Monday after posting losses six days in a row but volume was extremely thin and the market traded an inside day. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
